title: Do you understand now?
html_source:
This question, this part of the novel makes me think of the novel as a whole. Do you understand now? I can see Joyce thinking this as he finishes his work about the novel and about pragmatism; how he includes it in the novel and how society reacts to his work.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Yea, it’s like a challenger.
